definitions: A musical performance by two singers or instrumentalists, often with one providing the main melody and the other a harmony or counter-melody, specifically in an audio-only format.
A feature in some audio recording or playback devices that allows two separate audio tracks or sources to be played or recorded simultaneously, creating a combined sound.
examples: They recorded an Audio Duet for their new album.
The software allows for easy creation of an Audio Duet.
The concert featured an unexpected Audio Duet.
